title: Graduate program or research group in STEM+ education research
description: One graduate program or research group in STEM education research, including discipline-based education research (DBER) and medical and health professions education. One file per program in programs/.

id.description: Matches the file name without .yml: institution, then discipline, lowercase with hyphens.

ror.description: Optional ROR identifier for the institution, e.g. https://ror.org/05hs6h993

home_department.description: The department, school, or institute that grants the degree. Name partner units after 'with'.

disciplines.description: Ids from schema/stemedplus_disciplines.json (the STEMEd+ disciplines kept in HuMeta).

faculty.description: Faculty who supervise education research students in this program.

url.description: Optional link to the program, research group, or department page.

source.description: Where this information came from (a web page, or 'Submitted by <name>, <role>').

last_verified.description: Date someone last confirmed the entry, YYYY-MM-DD.

needs_check.description: Fields that could not be confirmed from the source and should be checked with the program.
